Subject: Intimation of Conference Call. 
 
Ref.: Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)         
Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015”) 
 
Dear Sir/Madam 
In terms of the referred Regulation 30 read with Schedule III - Part A of SEBI Listing 
Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that, a conference call for analysts and 
investors has been scheduled on Saturday, 31st October, 2026 at 4:00 P.M. (IST) to discuss the 
unaudited financial results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026. 
 
 
Details of the conference call are enclosed for your kind reference. 
 
 
You are requested to take the same on record.  
 
Thanking You.  
 
For Clean Science and Technology Limited 
 
 
 
Ruchita Vij 
Company Secretary and Compliance officer
